title: Longest Streak of Ones
statement: A habit tracker records each day as `1` (habit done) or `0` (missed). Find the longest run of consecutive days on which the habit was done.
inputFormat: The first line contains an integer `n`.
The second line contains `n` binary digits (`0` or `1`) separated by spaces.
outputFormat: Print the length of the longest contiguous run of `1` values. Print `0` if there are none.

examples.explanation: Days 3 to 5 form a run of three.
Every run of ones has length one.

input: Line 2: n binary digits separated by spaces

private.complexity: O(n) single pass with a current-run counter and a best counter.
private.notes: Update the best value inside the loop (or after it), otherwise a run that ends at the last day is missed.
